ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Arkade Developers Limited Q1 FY27 Earnings Call**  Arkade Developers reported a 9% year-on-year increase in Q1 FY27 pre-sales to INR 155 crores, supported by a robust development pipeline of INR 12,800 crores GDV and a strong balance sheet with minimal net debt (INR 5 crores). While current quarter profitability moderated (EBITDA 18.9%, PAT 13%) due to lower other income and increased employee costs, management expects a recovery to 25-26% EBITDA margins, with FY27 pre-sales targeted at INR 1,000 crores, stemming from significant INR 3,000 crores planned launches. A material impact includes the delay of the high-GDV Anand Nagar project until FY29 due to external regulatory height restrictions, though no immediate red flags concerning overall project viability or market demand were identified.
